::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 163,919 people lived in County Wexford, up 9.5% on 2016. It had the 9th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 81% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Wexford was €1,179, the 16th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
